title: Something Big Is Coming for Taurus
youtube_title: Big shifts for Taurus this week #shorts
youtube_description: Taurus, this week’s Uranus sextile and Mercury stations stir unexpected breakthroughs in love and career. Discover how to harness the Jupiter trine for a raise and the powerful Thursday finance shift. Comment your sign for a personalized reading!

captions_structure.text: Brace yourself, Taurus – an intense planetary shuffle will test your earth stability.

script_text: Brace yourself, Taurus – an intense planetary shuffle will test your earth stability. Monday’s Mercury trine Saturn in your 6th House boosts productivity, making it your productive day. Wednesday’s Mars square Pluto in your 10th House creates career pressure, worst day for conflict. Mid-week, a Uranus sextile to your 1st House ignites bold actions. Thursday Mercury stations direct in your 2nd House, finances as Venus enters your 7th House for romance. Saturday Jupiter trines your 10th House, delivering a lucky career boost. Sunday Mercury opposes Saturn in your 3rd House, causing brief communication hiccups. Thursday is your power day because Mercury stations direct in your 2nd House. Wednesday is your challenge day as Mars forms a square to your 8th House Neptune, stirring emotional turbulence. Create a budget by Friday and use the weekend’s Jupiter trine for a raise or partnership. Follow for daily updates.
